units: Yoma 42ᵇ, v. מֵילָא II.—Esp. מִמַּשְׁמַע by implication, constructively.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 3:5:3">Y. Erub. III, 21ᵇ</cite> top; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 1:4:4">Y. Ned. I, end, 37ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="E00648"><he>הֵן</he></cite>.—<he>ממ׳ שנאמר … איני יודע וכ׳</he> by mere logical conclusion from the text …, would I not learn that &c.? <cite ref="Bava Batra 110a:2">B. Bath. 110ᵃ</cite> <he>ממ׳ שנאמר וכ׳</he> when the text says ‘the daughter of Amminadab’, do I not know that she is the sister of N.? <cite ref="Bava Metzia 113a">B. Mets. 113ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מַשְׁמָעוֹת</he>. Y. Yoma V, 43ᵃ top <he>מ׳ ביניהון</he> they differ only as to the grammatical construction of the text (without any difference in the law of the case).—<he>מַשְׁמְעוֹת דורשין איכא בינייהו</he> they differ only as to the texts from which the law is derived.
